title: Likes paging code cleanups from the RF-132 reviews, with no behavior change
acceptance: Dead and duplicated code from RF-132 is removed: the unused onUnexpectedNext 'throw' branch and the stale readAppleLibraryPages doc, the unused array-returning adapter wrappers, the likes cursor codec duplicated with class-list pagination, the paging helper duplicated with listClasses, and the repeated page-size and invalid-cursor 422 constants.

Dashboard likes state is simpler: likesSubsetNote and the selected connection state are computed once, the autoload budget is stored once, the autoload effect depends on the fields it reads rather than whole per-provider records, and sourceCandidateKey is reused only if it moves to apps/web/src/lib first (it lives in a component module, and lib/ must not import components; that is why Lane B skipped it).
The likes cursor header uses a neutral constant name instead of CLASS_LIST_NEXT_CURSOR_HEADER; the header value X-RitmoFit-Next-Cursor and OpenAPI stay unchanged.
The full CI gate passes with no test expectation changed except imports.
